description: A text block (mj-text). may contain inline HTML.

members.name: Align
members.description: Gets or sets the horizontal alignment (align).

members.name: Color
members.description: Gets or sets the text colour (color).

members.name: Content
members.description: Gets or sets the inline HTML content of the block.

members.name: FontFamily
members.description: Gets or sets the font family (font-family).

members.name: FontSize
members.description: Gets or sets the font size (font-size).

members.name: FontStyle
members.description: Gets or sets the font style, e.g. italic (font-style).

members.name: FontWeight
members.description: Gets or sets the font weight (font-weight).

members.name: Height
members.description: Gets or sets the explicit height (height).

members.name: LetterSpacing
members.description: Gets or sets the letter spacing (letter-spacing).

members.name: LineHeight
members.description: Gets or sets the line height (line-height).

members.name: TextDecoration
members.description: Gets or sets the text decoration (text-decoration).

members.name: TextTransform
members.description: Gets or sets the text transform (text-transform).
